primary.title: Patanjali Foods shares to be in focus on Monday as Q1 net profit jumps 86%; revenue hits record
primary.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a robust June-quarter performance, with net profit increasing by 86% YoY to ₹335.73 crore and the highest-ever revenue of ₹11,337.45 crore. A 40% interim dividend has also been declared for FY27.
